mapper.delete: delete from sys_work_timeline_event where work_id = #{workId} and chapter_no = #{chapterNo}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_timeline_event (work_id, chapter_no, seq, event_type, fact, actors, props, status, deadline_no, story_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{workId}, #{chapterNo}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, #{fact}, #{actors}, #{props}, #{status}, #{deadlineNo}, #{storyTime}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_work_timeline_event set status = '已兑现', update_time = now() where work_id = #{workId} and chapter_no < #{beforeNo} and status = '未兑现' and #{keyword} is not null and fact like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
